findings.title: Elemental resistances remain capped with substantial overcap
findings.detail: The level 51 PoB sets resistancePenalty=-30. Fire, Cold, and Lightning are all capped at 75%, with +53%, +37%, and +30% overcap respectively. This is strong coverage for the configured penalty.
findings.action: Keep the elemental caps, but use some spare overcap room for Chaos Resistance or Life on upgrades if those are the same quality.

findings.title: Chaos Resistance is slightly negative
findings.detail: Chaos Resistance is -4% after the configured -30% penalty. Chaos maximum hit is 2369, just below the 2464 Life pool because Chaos damage bypasses Energy Shield. Tolerance is allocated, so gear is the cleanest next source.
findings.action: Take the adjacent Chaos Resistance small 52095 for +13% (one point) and target Chaos Resistance on the next ring or other replaceable slot.

findings.title: Mine mana is still the main resource pressure
findings.detail: Pyroclast Mine is now selected in PoB: 10 Mana per mine and 33.43 Mana/sec, with 97 unreserved Mana and 8.5 Mana/sec regeneration. This gives a better current skill calculation than the previous export, but sustained throwing can still outpace regeneration.
findings.action: Keep the Mana Flask and test a full mine sequence plus an escape. Compare Inspiration against Controlled Destruction in PoB if the current setup stalls; don't switch without checking the damage tradeoff.

findings.title: Life, armour, evasion, and hit thresholds improved sharply
findings.detail: Since level 46, Life increased 1645→2464, Armour 735→884, Evasion 202→654, and physical maximum hit 1955→2819. PoB reports 109 Life/sec regeneration, including the Mine Mastery conditional recovery; total EHP is 6105, elemental maximum hit 9475, and Chaos maximum hit 2369. Block remains 26%, while Spell Suppression is only 5%.
findings.action: The next tree priorities are Life/ES and meaningful spell suppression. Remember that the 109/sec regeneration includes the 'detonated a Mine Recently' condition.

findings.title: Tolerance and Sentinel routes are verified allocated
findings.detail: Six new passive nodes complete both routes: Strength 46578 → Strength 28330 → Sentinel 19144, and Chaos Resistance/Avoidance 57746 → Poison Avoidance 62490 → Tolerance 10511. The tree now has 65 allocated nodes.
findings.action: The optional 13% Chaos Resistance small node 52095 next to Tolerance is still unallocated; it is the next suggested one-point stop.

findings.title: Two gear slots still offer clear defensive upgrades
findings.detail: The rare Body Armour has no explicit Life modifier. Ring 2 provides +20% Lightning and +14% Fire Resistance, but its 7% Elemental Damage with Attack Skills does not scale Pyroclast Mine. Current elemental overcaps provide room to trade some resistance for Chaos Resistance and Life.
findings.action: Prioritize a rare ring with Life and Chaos Resistance, then a Life chest if one appears without breaking resistance caps. The old magic weapon can later be upgraded to a spell/fire damage or +gem-level weapon.

findings.title: Gear upgrades delivered a large HCSSF step forward
findings.detail: New amulet, helmet, shield, gloves, boots, and belt supply substantial Life, Mana, regeneration, resistance, and 5% Spell Suppression. The three life flasks include one 50%-instant Sacred Flask with conditional shock immunity; the third slot remains another life flask.
findings.action: Keep the instant flask. Consider using two life flasks plus a Granite or Jade Flask if flask coverage feels safe; the current armour and evasion are still modest.

findings.title: The main 4-link is coherent and now calculated as Pyroclast Mine
findings.detail: Pyroclast Mine 10 (2% quality) is linked to Swift Assembly 13, Trap and Mine Damage 11, and Controlled Destruction 11. The utility gems are Purity of Elements 10, Skitterbots 11, Flammability 10, Flame Dash 12, and Automation 9 with Detonate Mines 1.
findings.action: No missing required utility support stands out. If available, test Inspiration as a mana-friendly alternative to Controlled Destruction; consider Enlighten only if reservation becomes a problem.

findings.title: Major Pantheon is not selected in the export
findings.detail: The PoB leaves the major Pantheon as None and uses Tukohama as the minor Pantheon.
findings.action: Select a major Pantheon you have unlocked in game/PoB; this is a free defensive layer.

findings.title: Reliquarian unique-derived effect is still unallocated
findings.detail: The active tree contains the Reliquarian start and passive-point nodes, but no unique-display node. The currently equipped items are rares and magic.
findings.action: No need to spend points on a unique display without a specific useful unique available.

nextActions: Current elemental resistances are capped at 75% under the PoB's -30% penalty, with +53% Fire, +37% Cold, and +30% Lightning overcap. Chaos Resistance is -4%; the efficient next point is Chaos Resistance 52095 (+13%) directly from allocated Tolerance 10511.

After the one-point Chaos Resistance stop, prioritize the Melding route from allocated Intelligence 37671: Life/ES 61320 → Life/ES 63799 → Life/ES 55247 → Melding 18865 (4 points; total +16% maximum Life, +15% maximum ES, and 3% of Life as extra ES).
Next take Instinct from allocated Intelligence 4502: Spell Suppression/ES Recharge 49515 → 9769 → Instinct 24067 (3 points; +22% spell suppression and 50 ES recovered when you suppress).
Saboteur is a later damage route from allocated Trickery 35894: Elemental Damage 21575 → Mine Throwing Speed 7920 → Saboteur 46965 (3 points; +30% Mine Damage and up to 2 additional Remote Mines).

The rare Body Armour has no explicit Life modifier. Prefer a replacement with Life while retaining enough resistance; consider replacing Ring 2 with Life and Chaos Resistance, since its attack elemental damage modifier does not scale Pyroclast Mine.

Mana is the main gem-setup check: Pyroclast Mine costs 10 per mine and 33.4 Mana/sec in this calculation, against 8.5/sec regeneration and 97 unreserved. Keep the Mana Flask; if sustain is still uncomfortable, test Inspiration in place of Controlled Destruction in PoB and compare damage/cost before switching.

The active Pyroclast 4-link is level 10 / quality 2 + Swift Assembly 13 + Trap and Mine Damage 11 + Controlled Destruction 11. Purity of Elements, Skitterbots, and Flammability have no linked supports; no support is mandatory, but Enlighten could be tested if found and reservation becomes tight.
The export leaves the major Pantheon unset (minor Tukohama). Select an available major Pantheon in game/PoB for another defensive layer.
